config.label: Snipe-IT API base URL including /api/v1, for example https://snipe-it
config.description: Snipe-IT API base URL including /api/v1, for example https://snipe-it.example.com/api/v1. Use https.

config.label: Snipe-IT Personal API Token (JWT), from Snipe-IT > User > Manage API Keys
config.description: Snipe-IT Personal API Token (JWT), from Snipe-IT > User > Manage API Keys. It acts with the rights of its user.

config.label: Write guard, on by default: write tools return a preview until called again with confirm: "YES"
config.description: Write guard, on by default: write tools return a preview until called again with confirm: "YES". Only false, 0, no or off disable it.

config.label: Timeout in ms per HTTP attempt, including the body read (positive integer)
config.description: Timeout in ms per HTTP attempt, including the body read (positive integer).

config.label: Log level on stderr: debug, info, warn or error
config.description: Log level on stderr: debug, info, warn or error.

config.label: Cap for one tool result in bytes (serialized JSON), minimum 65536
config.description: Cap for one tool result in bytes (serialized JSON), minimum 65536. Larger results come back shortened with truncated: true.

config.label: Overall deadline for one tool call in ms, across retries and all: true pagination
config.description: Overall deadline for one tool call in ms, across retries and all: true pagination. 0 means none.

config.label: true masks personal data (email, username, names of people, phone, address, employee number) in tool results
config.description: true masks personal data (email, username, names of people, phone, address, employee number) in tool results.

config.label: true masks secrets (password/secret/token/api_key fields, secret custom field values) in tool results with (redacted)
config.description: true masks secrets (password/secret/token/api_key fields, secret custom field values) in tool results with (redacted).

config.label: true refuses every write at runtime; all tools stay registered and reads work
config.description: true refuses every write at runtime; all tools stay registered and reads work.

config.label: true (with the write guard on): confirm: "YES" executes only after a preview of the same request
config.description: true (with the write guard on): confirm: "YES" executes only after a preview of the same request.
